correctness.rationale: Coordinates are exactly six ±2e_i and eight (±1,±1,±1), Euclidean inclusive thresholds; squared pair distances 3,4,8,11,12,16 with no other changes. At q=3 the rhombic dodecahedron one-skeleton has 14 vertices/24 edges and wedge11 circles. At q=4 the added 12 cube edges triangulate its 12 rhombi to a connected closed 2-manifold of Euler characteristic two, S2. For q=8, independently regenerated all 240 flag faces from actual coordinates and replayed all 80 recorded certificate pairs, verifying at each step present faces, codimension-one and exactly one coface; the remaining 80 faces are the induced complex on eight cube corners, whose complement four antipodal edges makes the join of 4 copies of S0 = S3. At q=11 seven missing edges are a perfect matching on 14 vertices giving (S0)^{*7}=S6. At q=12 each cube corner becomes a cone apex. Homology dimensions are separated at adjacent stages, giving the asserted complete reduced integral barcodes.
